description: Periodically re-executes SELECT queries against user-selected Oracle tables and emits the resulting rows as JSON documents, resuming from a persisted cursor column (by default the row's ORA_ROWSCN).

spec.sslPolicy: Optional `advanced.sslmode` string appended as an `sslmode=` query parameter on the go-ora DSN; enum disable|allow|prefer|require|verify-ca|verify-full. No default is set by the connector, so when unset the go-ora driver default applies.
spec.tunnelSupport: Optional `networkTunnel.sshForwarding` (sshEndpoint `ssh://user@host[:port]` + private key). When in use the tunnel is started before connecting and the DSN host is rewritten to `localhost:1521` while the tunnel forwards to the configured address on port 1521.

credentialModes.name: SSH bastion key (tunnel only, not database auth)

scheme.description: Optional SSH forwarding credential: `networkTunnel.sshForwarding.sshEndpoint` plus a PEM private key in `networkTunnel.sshForwarding.privateKey`. Layered underneath the database user/password; never replaces it.

defaultSchedule.description: Connector-wide default `advanced.poll`; a Go duration string (e.g. '5m', '6h') or a literal of the form 'daily at HH:MMZ'. Defaults to '5m' when unset. Overridable per binding via the resource's `poll` field.

continuity.ourSideLoss: Deleted rows are never observed (each poll only reads rows still present with cursor > checkpoint), and with the default ORA_ROWSCN cursor an update that lowers no SCN is invisible only if SCN does not advance — but nothing expires with time. If a table is recreated or its SCNs reset, the persisted cursor can sit above all current values and the binding silently stops producing rows.
continuity.notes: Purely client-side polling: no replication slot, publication, change table, scratch table, or server-side session state is created. The connector holds only ordinary read-only SELECT sessions and a per-binding cursor tuple in Flow's own checkpoint state. Pausing between ticks costs nothing on the customer's Oracle instance; the only cost is a longer next sweep. Note ORA_ROWSCN is block-granular by default, so multiple rows share an SCN — the connector only checkpoints at boundaries between distinct cursor values so that a resume `WHERE ORA_ROWSCN > :1` cannot skip a co-SCN sibling.

configFields.name: address
configFields.description: Host or host:port at which the database can be reached; ':1521' is appended when no port is given.

configFields.name: user
configFields.description: Database user to authenticate as. Default 'flow_capture'.

configFields.name: password
configFields.description: Password for the specified database user.

configFields.name: database
configFields.description: Logical database name to capture from; default 'ORCL'. Emitted as the path segment of the oracle:// DSN, i.e. the go-ora service name. No TNS alias / tnsnames.ora / full connect-descriptor support is present.

configFields.name: advanced.poll
configFields.description: Connector-wide default schedule. Go duration string or 'daily at HH:MMZ'. Defaults to '5m'.

configFields.name: advanced.discover_schemas
configFields.description: If set, only tables whose OWNER is in this list are discovered. Omit to discover from all non-excluded schemas.

configFields.name: advanced.sslmode
configFields.description: Overrides SSL behavior by setting the DSN 'sslmode' parameter; one of disable/allow/prefer/require/verify-ca/verify-full.

configFields.name: advanced.source_tag
configFields.description: Literal value copied into /_meta/source/tag of every emitted document.

configFields.name: advanced.feature_flags
configFields.description: Estuary-internal comma-separated flag string; known flag 'emit_sourced_schemas' (default on).

configFields.name: networkTunnel.sshForwarding.sshEndpoint
configFields.description: Bastion host in the form ssh://user@hostname[:port]. Required when the networkTunnel object is present.

configFields.name: networkTunnel.sshForwarding.privateKey
configFields.description: Multiline PEM private key used to authenticate to the SSH bastion. Required when the networkTunnel object is present.

configFields.name: name
configFields.description: Unique name of this binding; also the resource path pointer (/name).

configFields.name: owner
configFields.description: Oracle schema (OWNER) of the captured table. Required unless a query template override is supplied.

configFields.name: table
configFields.description: Table to capture. Required unless a query template override is supplied.

configFields.name: cursor
configFields.description: Column names whose values are persisted between query executions as the resume cursor. Discovery sets this to the single synthetic column ['TXID'] (ORA_ROWSCN). Empty means full refresh every poll. Changing this list resets the binding's stored cursor.

configFields.name: poll
configFields.description: Per-binding override of the connector default schedule; same grammar (Go duration or 'daily at HH:MMZ').

configFields.name: template
configFields.description: Go text/template rendered into the executed SQL. Template context exposes .IsFirstQuery, .CursorFields (already double-quote-quoted), .Owner, .TableName, plus funcs add/quoteTableName/quoteIdentifier.

discovery.method: Three Oracle data-dictionary queries against ALL_TABLES, ALL_TAB_COLUMNS, and ALL_CONSTRAINTS/ALL_CONS_COLUMNS, joined in Go on owner+table_name into one table-info map.
discovery.querySketch: tables: SELECT DISTINCT(NVL(IOT_NAME, TABLE_NAME)) AS table_name, owner FROM all_tables WHERE tablespace_name NOT IN (<system tablespaces>) AND owner NOT IN (<system owner list>) AND table_name NOT IN (<internal table list>) [AND owner IN (<discover_schemas>)]  ||  columns: SELECT t.owner, t.table_name, t.column_name, t.column_id, t.nullable, t.data_type, t.data_precision, t.data_scale, t.data_length FROM all_tab_columns t WHERE t.owner NOT IN (<system owner list>) AND t.table_name NOT IN (<internal table list>) ORDER BY t.table_name, t.column_id  ||  primary keys: SELECT t.owner, t.table_name, t.column_name, c.position FROM all_tab_columns t INNER JOIN (SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.constraint_type, ac.column_name, ac.position FROM all_constraints c INNER JOIN all_cons_columns ac ON c.constraint_name = ac.constraint_name AND c.table_name = ac.table_name AND c.owner = ac.owner AND c.constraint_type = 'P') c ON (t.owner = c.owner AND t.table_name = c.table_name AND t.column_name = c.column_name) WHERE t.owner NOT IN (<system owner list>) AND t.table_name NOT IN (<internal table list>) ORDER BY t.table_name, c.position
excludes: views are not discovered: only ALL_TABLES is queried and every discovered binding is generated with tableType 'TABLE' (despite the doc comment claiming information_schema.tables)
index-organized tables are collapsed to their IOT_NAME via NVL(IOT_NAME, TABLE_NAME) with DISTINCT
discovery.allowlist: advanced.discover_schemas, when non-empty, adds `AND owner IN ('<...>')` to the ALL_TABLES query only. It is passed to the columns and primary-key helpers but those functions ignore the parameter; the intersection still holds because columns/keys are attached only to tables already in the table map.

schedule.description: Go duration string, or 'daily at HH:MMZ'. Per-binding `poll` wins over the endpoint `advanced.poll` default.

backfill.querySketch: SELECT ORA_ROWSCN AS TXID, "<OWNER>"."<TABLE>".* FROM "<OWNER>"."<TABLE>" ORDER BY ORA_ROWSCN
backfill.chunking: Not chunked at the SQL level — no LIMIT/FETCH FIRST/ROWNUM bound is ever emitted. One poll issues a single unbounded ordered SELECT and streams the result set; boundedness/resumability comes entirely from the ORDER BY plus a Flow checkpoint emitted every 1000 documents, and only at a boundary where the cursor value changes (persisting the PREVIOUS row's cursor so co-SCN rows are never skipped by the next `> :1`). Watchdogs abort a poll after 30m with no first row, or 5m of no subsequent rows. At most 5 bindings poll concurrently (weighted semaphore).

incremental.querySketch: SELECT ORA_ROWSCN AS TXID, "<OWNER>"."<TABLE>".* FROM "<OWNER>"."<TABLE>" WHERE ORA_ROWSCN > :1 ORDER BY ORA_ROWSCN
incremental.chunking: Same as backfill: unbounded ordered SELECT per poll, narrowed only by `ORA_ROWSCN > :1` bound to the checkpointed SCN. The cursor is carried between polls in the connector's own state document (`bindingStateV1.<stateKey>.CursorValues`, alongside CursorNames and LastPolled) and bound back as :1 on the next poll.

schedule.description: Go duration string, or 'daily at HH:MMZ'.

backfill.chunking: Unbounded ordered SELECT; see the ORA_ROWSCN archetype — identical checkpoint-every-1000-rows-at-cursor-boundary mechanism.

incremental.querySketch: SELECT * FROM "<OWNER>"."<TABLE>" WHERE ("<C1>" > :1) OR ("<C1>" = :1 AND "<C2>" > :2) ORDER BY "<C1>", "<C2>"  -- lexicographic tuple-greater-than expanded over all cursor columns
incremental.chunking: Unbounded ordered SELECT narrowed by the lexicographic cursor predicate. Because go-ora requires each placeholder occurrence to be unique, the rendered `:N` placeholders are rewritten to a fresh sequential numbering with argument values duplicated to match before execution.

schedule.description: Go duration string, or 'daily at HH:MMZ'.

snapshot.chunking: No WHERE, no ORDER BY, no row limit — the whole table is re-read on every poll. Checkpoints are emitted every 1000 documents purely for throughput; the persisted cursor stays empty so a restart re-reads from the top.

authTierRationale: The only database credential is a plain Oracle username/password plus host and service name, assembled locally into an oracle:// DSN. There is no OAuth app to register and no refresh token. The optional SSH-tunnel private key is an additional self-supplied secret, not a third-party app registration, so it does not raise the tier.

unionMisfits.description: The executed SQL is not fixed by the connector: `template` (a Go text/template with .IsFirstQuery, .CursorFields, .Owner, .TableName and add/quoteTableName/quoteIdentifier funcs) can replace the query entirely, and a binding with a template need not name a table at all. PullSpec 'table' has no slot for a user-supplied query template, and PullSpec 'query' has no slot for the cursor-column state that drives it.

TXID is not a real column. It is an alias the connector's own SQL projects over the Oracle pseudocolumn ORA_ROWSCN, and it is selected by a magic-string check (`len(cursor)==1 && cursor[0]=="TXID"`) that swaps in a different query template. A schema field typed as a column name cannot express 'synthetic pseudocolumn projected by the connector'.

cursorField.name: TXID
cursorField.granularity: block-level unless the table is created with ROWDEPENDENCIES; multiple rows may share a value

unionMisfits.description: The schedule grammar is a single string accepting two disjoint forms — a Go duration ('5m', '6h', '500ms') or a fixed daily UTC wall-clock time ('daily at 12:34Z') — enforced by one regex. Neither maps onto 'interval' (Go durations are richer and signed per the pattern) nor 'cron'. Emitted as kind 'other'; a first-class 'daily_at' schedule kind would fit better.

There is no bounded chunk in the SQL sense. The schema's `chunking` field implies a per-request bound (LIMIT/OFFSET/keyset window); here a poll is one unbounded streaming result set and 'bounded resumable slice' is realized after the fact by checkpoint placement in the row loop.

chunking.checkpointBoundary: only at a change in cursor tuple; persists the previous row's cursor

abstained.transports[0].spec.sslPolicy.default: The connector never sets a default sslmode; the effective behavior when the field is omitted is decided inside github.com/sijms/go-ora/v2, which is not vendored in the mined directory.
abstained.execution.continuity.resumeWindow: Nothing in the connector expires with elapsed time — there is no retention window, slot, or resume token. Left null rather than inventing a bound.
abstained.streams[0].writeDisposition: The connector emits documents plus a collection key and never emits deletion tombstones, so downstream behavior is reduce-by-key ('merge') for keyed tables. It is Flow's materialization, not this connector, that ultimately decides; classified from the key choice only.
abstained.streams[].name: There is no literal stream list — bindings come entirely from the customer's ALL_TABLES contents, named `<lowercased owner>_<lowercased table>` with non-[a-z0-9-_.] characters replaced by underscores. All three entries are archetypes.
abstained.discovery.method.views: The Discover doc comment claims tables AND views from information_schema.tables, but the code queries only ALL_TABLES and hardcodes tableType "TABLE"; whether views were ever discovered could not be determined from this directory.
abstained.streams[1].cursorField: For a user-configured multi-column cursor there is no single cursor field; the ordered tuple lives in `cursorColumns`. The scalar field carries only the leading column.
